tests_documented.instructions: Does `description` explicitly say whether tests were added or updated for this change?

criteria.met: clearly states the test status of this change
criteria.uncertain: hedges or implies something about tests without confirming it
criteria.absent: does not mention tests at all

breaking_change_documented.instructions: Does `description` explicitly say whether this is a breaking change?

criteria.met: clearly states whether this does or does not break existing behavior
criteria.uncertain: hedges on whether existing behavior is affected
criteria.absent: does not address breaking changes at all

rollback_documented.instructions: Does `description` explain how to roll this change back if it causes problems?

criteria.met: gives a concrete way to revert or fall back
criteria.uncertain: implies a fallback exists without describing it
